name: NRG World Heavyweight Title
epitaph: The promotion's own top singles prize, defended in a ladder match rematch of the two men's first encounter six years earlier.
notes: The reign recorded here is confirmed defended in NRG's own show-recap post (31 July 2006), which frames the match as a rematch of a first encounter shown in the night's own video package as taking place in 2000.

name: NRG World Tag Team Titles
epitaph: The promotion's own tag team title, shown held in the night's own video recap package rather than defended on the card itself.
notes: No document in the held record shows this title defended; the reign recorded here rests on the show's own pre-taped video package, which shows the champions holding the belts aloft.
